notes: Dedicated CPU collection traffic. These timings are not an additional latency benchmark.
There are quiet gaps between phases so whole-second platform groups can be checked against expected counts.
Measured phases use at least 350 ms between request starts to reduce adaptive sampling. Sampling and ingestion uncertainty must still be reported.
Warmups are separate. Six-second gaps before auth warmups allow the non-sliding five-second cache entry to expire; no auth refresh request is hidden inside a measured phase.
Auth TTL misses in source and response-HIT phases remain visible. Only an all-HIT/KV0 cohort may be labeled auth-hit-only.
Every JSON result is checked against the saved full base64 reference. No extra provider call, retry, upload, or configuration change is made.
